scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run test:avatar-assets && vite build --config vite.config.ts && npm run test:viewport
scripts.test:e2e:guest: npm run build && playwright test --config tests/guest-session/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:child-profile: npm run build && playwright test --config tests/child-profile/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:design-quality: npm run build && cross-env DESIGN_AUDIT_PHASE=after playwright test --config tests/design-quality/playwright.config.ts
scripts.audit:design:before: npm run build && cross-env DESIGN_AUDIT_PHASE=before playwright test --config tests/design-quality/playwright.config.ts
